rationale: The assistant correctly tied 22E to an evaporator fan iced up and read the scraping sound and weak airflow sensibly, and it ended with an engineer referral plus practical food-preservation advice, all without unsafe instructions. However it never properly recommended the key diagnostic step (a full unplugged manual defrost) and in fact muddled the customer out of it ('You don't need to unplug it for 24 hours if you have your cool box ready'), while detouring into poorly answerable checks (drain hole, 'No Frost' label, listening at night for 'a faint hiss or bubbling', compressor cycling). It leaned too hard on a defrost heater/thermostat failure ('because the underlying component has failed') without a defrost test, and omitted any pointer to Samsung/Currys warranty despite the 3-year-old appliance. Useful direction overall but incomplete and somewhat confusing for the homeowner.
